title: Mishlove's remote viewing trial at SRI

tellings.quote: So in February 1976, they had invited me to SRRI to experience remote viewing, which I did and and had a very successful trial at the time.

plain: In February 1976 a researcher named Jeffrey Mishlove was invited to the Stanford Research Institute, a research lab in California, to try remote viewing, the practice of describing a far-off place using only the mind. Mishlove says he took part in a trial there run by the physicists Hal Puthoff and Russell Targ and that it was "very successful", which would mean the mind can perceive places it cannot see.
